scope: Synthetic outbox byte budgets, priority fairness, leases, and Cassandra large-backlog memory; no intended-topology acceptance

before.postgres: Six events returned for the three-MiB payload fixture, rather than a byte-bounded prefix
before.cassandra: Fresh and reused 256MiB-heap fixtures failed during backlog setup; an offheap-only attempt exhausted the 128MiB direct allowance; later compaction still exhausted the heap before small-heap G1 overrides
before.ordering_assertion: One early run failed a combined oldest-ID/payload-hash assertion without logging which comparison failed. Its cause was not established. Diagnostic output and explicitly ordered past creation timestamps were added; five later stress runs passed, including the final fixture. Preserve this limitation when interpreting the evidence.

after.boundary_policy: One complete boundary event per nonempty priority class; regular work has reserved capacity

cassandra_stress.notes: Server lifetime memory reached its hard ceiling; raw charged peak and memory.events are in runtime.json/server-health.log. RSS and cgroup accounting measure different things. No server OOM or OOM kill occurred.

limits: Synthetic RF=1 single-node Cassandra, not RF=3 separate-kernel k3s
